{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999].shape[0]}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id values: {df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")

# Check for re-testing via sample_seq
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique().gt(1).sum()}")

# Check the distribution of assay_batch
print(f"Assay batch distribution:\n{df['assay_batch'].value_counts()}")

# Check the distribution of severity by arm
print(f"Severity by arm:\n{pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity'])}")"}
